プライバシーとセキュリティ画面設定

observation.happening: Error notification banner showing failed attempt to open a settings screen. Displays both the error message and a secondary context line. Offers a retry action button and dismiss option.
observation.most_important: Two-line error message on left indicating settings screen failed to load; blue action button for retry; red alert icon signals error severity
observation.next_action: User can click blue retry button to attempt opening settings again, or dismiss with × button
anomalies: Large red circular icon on right takes disproportionate visual weight relative to text message
Two lines of Japanese text have unclear visual hierarchy - main error vs. supporting detail distinction could be stronger
Icon and button spacing creates slight visual imbalance; circle icon feels disconnected from linear text composition

ai_look: Generic alert banner pattern seen across many apps
Red circle icon feels isolated and template-like
Simple centered-row layout without particular refinement
Standard error state implementation without distinctive visual treatment
FF03.why: Functional and clear error notification that works as intended. Message hierarchy is readable, state is unambiguous, Japanese localization is present. However, the visual execution is conventional - similar patterns exist in many products. The large red circle icon creates imbalance rather than adding clarity. Lacks the refinement and distinctive character expected in world-class desktop products like Linear, Raycast, or Apple's system UI. Well-executed competence, but forgettable design.
